title: A lane's own `merge --review-record` was refused by the merge-confirm-repo guard (likely a missing --confirm flag; false alarm unlikely)
why:
Sighting (lane export-holds-every-record on PR #3468; coordinator 01:49 CST Nov 15, relayed; guard record and code unread by triage): guard merge-confirm-repo refused `merge.py 3468 --review-record --confirm ...` three times, although the lane had run get_session alone first and its tags named cs-repo:shivinate7/claude-settings. Refusal text, verbatim from the lane: "this session's own record does not prove it may merge in the checkout this command acts in". The lane's last try used `-C /home/user/claude-settings`. Mistake: a lane typed a flag the tool does not have (--confirm; see the 02:06 UPDATE below), which is a normal slip Claude is likely to hit again; the refusal itself is likely right, so the guard is probably not crying wolf (rule: a guard that goes red when nothing is wrong is spent: unproven here). Harm: three refused calls, then the lane hand-posted a record through the GitHub tool, which the coordinator ruled void (see status-page-size-cap): lost lane time and a re-post by runner 10. Unmeasured: whether `-C` (a command that acts in another checkout than the session's own) also matters; whether other lanes hit it; the guard's own record. First act of a lane: read the guard record and reproduce with and without `-C` and without --confirm; say whether any false alarm remains. A change to what the guard lets through is a guard-verdict change: round 3 applies, and a form only an attacker would write does not count. Kin: merge-confirm-head-short-sha, lane-lint-background-refused.

02:03 CST Nov 15 PATTERN (triage's count from today's relays; every refusal text is relayed, none read by triage): five sightings, all of the form "a lane records its own review with the merge tool". CLASSIFIER (3): (1) [Undermining Oversight] on the `--lint` recorder, lane export-holds-every-record, PR #3468; (2) [Destructive or Unwanted Actions] on a lane's own `--review-record --confirm`, lane worktree-removal-decision-repo-scope, PR #3455, 02:03 CST; (3) the denial of printing the old head's rounds, lane solo-batch-hat, PR #2701 (owner item 862, open). GUARD (1 sighting, 3 refusals): merge-confirm-repo on a lane's own record, PR #3468 (step merge-confirm-own-record-alarm). Likely a nonexistent --confirm flag (see the 02:06 UPDATE). MERGE TOOL (1): the tool refused a first one-round record on PR #2787 because an older record chain exists (not a guard or the classifier). Common cause unmeasured. One owner decision may cover the family: "May a lane post its own review record and lint comment with the merge tool in its own session, or does only runner 10 post them?" Not posted: the coordinator brings it to triage only if runner 10 meets the same refusal (coordinator pick 02:04 CST: runner 10 posts, the lane neither retries nor hand-posts). Items 862 and 863 are open on two of the three classifier cases.

02:06 CST Nov 15 UPDATE (runner 10's finding at 02:04, relayed by the coordinator at 02:06; triage read no code): `merge --review-record` never posts and takes no --confirm flag. It prints the record and says to post the lines as a PR comment (done with the GitHub MCP comment tool; PR #3455 comment 6891441431). `--fix-check` needs a full 40-hex head. So the guard merge-confirm-repo refusals of `merge.py 3468 --review-record --confirm ...` are most likely a missing flag: a false alarm is unlikely, not shown. The classifier refusals are a separate matter: they refused different acts (printing the old-round record, the --lint recorder, a lane's own record) and their cause is unmeasured. Wording downgrade: the step stays (a missing flag is likely hit again), but 'possible false alarm' now reads 'likely a missing flag; false alarm unlikely'. Usage-text note: step lane-hand-in-uses-review-record.

11:48 CST Nov 15 (lane solo-batch-hat receipt, coordinator, relayed): PR 2701's carried record is posted (comment 6898659188, carry note 6898659844) after the owner's `override 1h` at 11:46 CST. Item 862 can close (the lane's receipt).
